rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual reply for acknowledging or accepting something.

example.english: Want to have lunch together tomorrow? Alright.
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when agreeing warmly or enthusiastically to a suggestion or request.

example.jyutping: hou2 aa1 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ceot1 faat3 laa1

rows.note: Use this familiar loanword when you want a neutral, modern-sounding acknowledgement.

example.english: Alright, I’ll wait downstairs at five.
example.jyutping: ou1 kei1 ng5 dim2 zung1 hai2 lau4 haa6 dang2

rows.note: Use this when “alright” specifically reassures someone that there is no problem or objection.

example.english: Don’t worry, it’s alright; I’ll sort it out for you.
example.traditional: 你放心，冇問題，我幫你搞掂。
example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 sam1 mou5 man6 tai4 ngo5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6
